{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Water| trainername=Khoury| pokemonname=Croconaw| jtrainername=カズナリ| jpokemonname=アリゲイツ| tmtrainername=Kazunari| tmpokemonname=Alligates| image=[[File:Khoury Croconaw.png|250px]] | caption=Khoury's Croconaw| gender=Unknown| location=[[New Bark Town]] | evolution=1| numeps1=4| prevonum=158| evo1num=159| epnum=DP143| epname=An Egg Scramble!| firstevoep=DP147 | firstevoname=Bagged Then Tagged! | firststagename=Totodile| secondstagename=Croconaw| current=[[Party|With Khoury]] | java1=[[Miyako Itō]]| enva1=[[Kayzie Rogers]]| enva2=[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]]| java2=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]| }} '''Khoury's Croconaw''' (Japanese: '''カズナリのアリゲイツ''' ''Kazunari's Alligates'') is [[Khoury]]'s [[first partner Pokémon]]. ==History== [[File:Khoury and Croconaw.png|left|250px|thumb|Croconaw and Khoury]] Khoury's Croconaw first appeared as a Totodile in ''[[DP143|An Egg Scramble!]]''. When Khoury introduced it to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, it was unsociable and upset with the {{pkmn|food}} it was given. However, {{an|Brock}} crushed some [[Chesto Berry|Chesto Berries]] with a {{wp|mortar and pestle}} and sprinkled them on its food, which made Totodile want to eat the food. When he, {{Ash}}, and Brock were looking for {{TRT}}, who had stolen {{an|Dawn}}'s [[Pokémon Egg]], Khoury called for Totodile to fire its {{m|Water Gun}} up towards the sky as a signal to let Dawn and {{an|Lyra}} know where he was. Totodile was seen again at the beginning of [[DP144|the next episode]]. In ''[[DP145|A Rivalry to Gible On!]]'', Totodile was used to help track down a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Gible}} that was attacking people near a [[Pokémon Center]]. After getting into a scuffle with {{AP|Buizel}}, Totodile and its {{pkmn|Trainer}} were eventually able to find Gible. Totodile matched Gible's moves, wearing it down and allowing Khoury to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} it. In ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]'', Totodile was used in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] alongside Lyra's {{p|Chikorita}}, against [[Ash's Monferno]] and [[Dawn's Cyndaquil]]. In the heat of the battle, Totodile [[Evolution|evolved]] into Croconaw and Khoury learned from his [[Pokédex]] that it could use new attacks, such as {{m|Hydro Pump}}. Despite the type advantage it had over its opponents, Croconaw was unable to stand up to Monferno's {{m|Mach Punch}} and was defeated. ==Personality and characteristics== When {{AP|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} first introduced themselves to Totodile, it initially ignored them. However, it appears that the only reason Totodile was being unsociable was because it was upset that it had been given food it did not like. It was later seen being friendly with the other Pokémon. As a reflection of its Trainer, Totodile seems to care for Lyra as a friend, prompting her to get on stage at the festival and alerting her and the others that her {{TP|Lyra|Marill}} had wandered off. It also seems to be quite the competitive Pokémon, evidenced by its quarreling with {{AP|Buizel}} and fighting an unorthodox battle with Gible.
